hunks.baseline: The gazes of the four leaders and more than two hundred mounted bandits and nomads, who had been raising their cups in celebration of their plan to turn Shanxi Province upside down, all converged on the entrance.
hunks.sol: The gazes of the four leaders and of the more than two hundred mounted bandits and nomads—who had just been raising their cups in celebration of their plan to turn Shanxi Province upside down—all converged on the entrance.

hunks.baseline: Black Sand’s eyes narrowed as he identified the uninvited guest slowly walking toward them.
hunks.sol: Black Sand’s eyes narrowed as he made out the uninvited guest slowly walking toward them.

hunks.baseline: His unsteady gait made him look as though he could collapse at any moment. His wrinkled skin was ice-cold, and the breath escaping his lips was thin and faint.
hunks.sol: He tottered as though he might collapse at any moment. His wrinkled skin was ice-cold, and the breath escaping his lips was thin and faint.

hunks.baseline: Temur, Chinggen, and the Human Butcher watched the old man in silence for a while before exchanging a few words.
hunks.sol: Temur, Chinggen, and the Human Butcher watched him in silence for a while before exchanging a few words.

hunks.baseline: “What is it?”
hunks.sol: “What’s the matter?”

hunks.baseline: Black Sand’s reaction caused the others to sense the oddity as well.
hunks.sol: Black Sand’s reaction made the others sense the oddity as well.

hunks.baseline: The four men, including Black Sand, fell into thought.
hunks.sol: The four men, Black Sand included, fell into thought.

hunks.baseline: Then Sound Transmission slipped into the Human Butcher’s ear.
hunks.sol: Then a thread of Sound Transmission slipped into the Human Butcher’s ear.

hunks.baseline: — You’re worrying over nothing. That sickly old man?
hunks.sol: — You take caution too far. That scrawny old man?

hunks.baseline: “Where the hell is this?”
hunks.sol: “And where is this place?”

hunks.baseline: “Elder, are you feeling better now?”
hunks.sol: “Elder, have you come to your senses now?”

hunks.baseline: “W-Wait a moment.”
hunks.sol: “H-Hold on.”

hunks.baseline: Yet the old man had carved the two men apart with only a few words.
hunks.sol: Yet with a few words, the old man had carved apart the two men who commanded such respect and fear.

hunks.baseline: No one had the energy to be surprised anymore. In the midst of the atmosphere thick with shock and horror, the old man clicked his tongue and noticed the food laid out in front of the four men.
hunks.sol: No one had the energy to be surprised anymore. In the midst of the atmosphere thick with shock and horror, the old man clicked his tongue, noticed the food laid out in front of the four men, and his eyes went wide.

hunks.baseline: “Well, damn, you’ve laid out one hell of a feast. I was hungry, too. What a stroke of luck.”
hunks.sol: “Well, damn, you’ve laid out one hell of a feast. I was hungry, so this is perfect.”

hunks.baseline: “Wow, look how tender this meat is. It just melts on the tongue.”
hunks.sol: “Wow, look how tender this meat is. It just melts on the tongue. Melts.”

hunks.baseline: *Crunch, crunch.*
hunks.sol: *Chomp, chomp.*

hunks.baseline: It was the sound of the last thread of the Human Butcher’s reason snapping—and the death knell of a man.
hunks.sol: It was the sound of the last thread of the Human Butcher’s reason snapping—and the death rattle of a man.

hunks.baseline: *Crunch, crunch. Gulp. Guh-hup!*
hunks.sol: *Munch, munch. Gulp. Ahh.*

hunks.baseline: But it took no more than an instant for their confusion to become astonishment, and their astonishment to become horror.
hunks.sol: But it took no more than an instant for question marks to turn into exclamation marks, and dumbfoundedness into horror.

hunks.baseline: “Young people these days are a real problem. So rude. Is my name *old man*? Am I your friend?”
hunks.sol: “Young people these days have no manners, and it’s a real problem. Is my name *old man*? Am I your friend?”

hunks.baseline: Their limbs were mangled and their faces smashed as they were flung away. The sight made the leaders break into cold sweats.
hunks.sol: Every one of them was flung away with mangled limbs and smashed faces. The sight made the leaders break into cold sweats.

hunks.baseline: *How is he over there?*
hunks.sol: *How on earth is he over there?*

hunks.baseline: He had used a chicken bone to wield Sword Energy.

hunks.sol: The Human Butcher understood instinctively.

hunks.baseline: The plea of a butcher who had spent his entire life taking other people’s lives was an unbelievable sight.
hunks.sol: The plea of the Human Butcher, who had spent his entire life taking other people’s lives, was a sight no one could believe.
